effect.name: Krita Interpolation (Background)
effect.description: (The effect comes from the Krita) Subtract 0.5f by 1/4 of cosine of base layer subtracted by 1/4 of cosine of blend layer assuming 0-1 range. The result is similar to Allanon mode (Blend Average), but with more contrast and functional difference to 50% opacity.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Krita Interpolation (Background) Shader | 2026.07.04 */

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.
